  • Classes in com.eqixiac.equinix.internetaccess.model.json used by com.eqixiac.equinix.internetaccess.client.internal
    Class
    Description
    AccountAgreementJson
    Read-only JSON model for an AccountAgreement returned by the Equinix Internet Access (EIA) v1 account-agreements lookup (GET /internetAccess/v1/accounts/{accountNumber}/agreements).
    AccountDetailsJson
    Read-only JSON model for an AccountDetails returned by the Equinix Internet Access (EIA) v1 account lookups — the list (GET /internetAccess/v1/accounts) and the single-account get (GET /internetAccess/v1/accounts/{accountNumber}).
    CabinetJson
    Read-only JSON model for a Cabinet returned by the Equinix Internet Access (EIA) v1 product-availability lookup GET /internetAccess/v1/cabinets.
    CageJson
    Read-only JSON model for a Cage returned by the Equinix Internet Access (EIA) v1 product-availability lookup GET /internetAccess/v1/cages.
    ConnectionServiceJson
    Read-only JSON model for a ConnectionService returned by the Equinix Internet Access (EIA) v1 product-availability lookup GET /internetAccess/v1/connectionServices.
    CustomerRouteConfigurationJson
    Read-only JSON model for a CustomerRouteConfiguration returned by the Equinix Internet Access (EIA) v1 lookup GET /internetAccess/v1/customerRouteConfigurations.
    DedicatedBandwidthConfigurationJson
    Read-only JSON model for a DedicatedBandwidthConfiguration returned by the Equinix Internet Access (EIA) v1 lookup GET /internetAccess/v1/dedicatedBandwidthConfigurations.
    DedicatedPortDefaultConfigurationJson
    Read-only JSON model for a DedicatedPortDefaultConfiguration returned by the Equinix Internet Access (EIA) v1 lookup GET /internetAccess/v1/dedicatedPortDefaultConfigurations.
    IbxJson
    Read-only JSON model for an Ibx returned by the Equinix Internet Access (EIA) product-availability lookups — the v2 list (GET /internetAccess/v2/ibxs) and the v1 single-IBX get (GET /internetAccess/v1/ibxs/{ibx}).
    InternetAccessServiceJson
    Read-only JSON model for the ServiceReadModel / ServiceCreateResponse returned by the Equinix Internet Access (EIA) v2 service create, get-details, update and search operations.
    OperationalUnitJson
    Read-only JSON model for an OperationalUnit returned by the Equinix Internet Access (EIA) v1 operational-units lookup (GET /internetAccess/v1/operationalUnits).
    OrderDetailsJson
    Read-only JSON model for an OrderDetails returned by the Equinix Internet Access (EIA) v1 order single get (GET /internetAccess/v1/orders/{orderUUID}).
    PatchPanelJson
    Read-only JSON model for a PatchPanel returned by the Equinix Internet Access (EIA) v1 product-availability lookup GET /internetAccess/v1/patchPanels.
    PortConfigurationJson
    Read-only JSON model for a PortConfiguration returned by the Equinix Internet Access (EIA) v1 lookup GET /internetAccess/v1/portConfigurations.
    PriceJson
    Read-only JSON model for a Price returned by the Equinix Internet Access (EIA) v1 price search POST /internetAccess/v1/prices/search.
    PurchaseOrderJson
    Read-only JSON model for a PurchaseOrder returned by the Equinix Internet Access (EIA) v1 purchase-order lookups — the list (GET /internetAccess/v1/accounts/{accountNumber}/purchaseOrders) and the single get (GET /internetAccess/v1/accounts/{accountNumber}/purchaseOrders/{number}).
    RoutingProtocolConfigurationJson
    Read-only JSON model for a RoutingProtocolConfiguration returned by the Equinix Internet Access (EIA) v1 lookup GET /internetAccess/v1/routingProtocolConfigurations.
    SignaturePolicyJson
    Read-only JSON model for a SignaturePolicy returned by the Equinix Internet Access (EIA) v1 signature-policies lookup (GET /internetAccess/v1/signaturePolicies).
    TermsAndConditionsJson
    Read-only JSON model for TermsAndConditions returned by the Equinix Internet Access (EIA) v1 terms lookup (GET /internetAccess/v1/terms).
    VirtualBandwidthConfigurationJson
    Read-only JSON model for a VirtualBandwidthConfiguration returned by the Equinix Internet Access (EIA) v1 lookup GET /internetAccess/v1/virtualBandwidthConfigurations.
    VirtualConnectionDefaultConfigurationJson
    Read-only JSON model for a VirtualConnectionDefaultConfiguration returned by the Equinix Internet Access (EIA) v1 lookup GET /internetAccess/v1/virtualConnectionDefaultConfigurations.
